cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(pthread-impl C)

file(GLOB SOURCE c/*.c)

if(MINGW)
    add_library(pthread_impl STATIC ${SOURCE})
    target_include_directories(pthread_impl PUBLIC c/)
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(pthread_impl PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
elseif(WIN32)
    add_library(pthread_impl STATIC ${SOURCE})
    target_include_directories(pthread_impl PUBLIC c/)
    target_compile_definitions(pthread_impl PUBLIC WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
else()
    add_library(pthread_impl STATIC ${SOURCE})
    target_include_directories(pthread_impl PUBLIC c/)
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(pthread_impl PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
endif()
